text: Code reviews are a vital practice in software development, where team members examine each other's code before it is merged. One of their main benefits is catching bugs early, which saves time and money compared to fixing problems after release. Beyond finding errors, they encourage knowledge sharing, as less experienced developers learn from their peers and everyone stays familiar with different parts of the project. This process also improves overall team quality by building a shared standard for clean, maintainable code. While reviews require effort, they create a stronger, more collaborative team where mistakes are caught quickly and everyone grows together.
